title: Ep. 613: What Lessons Can We Learn From the Mitteler Rebbe's Liberation 200 Years Ago?
Mitteler Rebbe's Padah Beshalom part 3/9 שערי תשובה ד"ה פדה בשלום (פרק ד)
blurb: Link to מאמר PDF Continuing to describe the war of the two נפשות during Davening, the מיטעלער רבי explains why the מחשבות זרות are worse during this war than otherwise, based on the understanding of how קליפה generally feeds off of קדושה. Based on this, the מיטעלער רבי explains the three stages of the פסוק of "כי הנה אויביך ה', כי הנה אויביך יאבדו, יתפרדו כל פועלי און", as a reference to the two forms of קליפה born from one's מחשבות זרות subsequently being defeated through the battle of Davening.

title: יום ב' פ' ויצא, ו' כסלו, ה'תשפ"ז

title: The Teacher Who Needed Children and the Rebbe’s Promise
blurb: When a non-Lubavitch teacher from Yerushalayim came to the Rebbe seeking a bracha for children, she never imagined that a teaching job at Beis Rivkah in New York would become the answer to her tefillos. "When you care for the Rebbe's children, the Rebbe will care for yours," the Rebbe told her.

title: He Wanted a Better Way to Learn the Rebbe’s Maamarim, So He Built One
